findings.highlight: I can’t go back
findings.evidenceJa: 絶対に戻れない。
findings.governingReading: Using it means Shirou absolutely cannot return.
findings.explanation: The English preserves impossibility but drops the absolute emphasis.

findings.highlight: “Projection”
findings.evidenceJa: 「とう、え」
findings.governingReading: Shirou can produce only a broken phonetic fragment of the word.
findings.explanation: The English restores the complete technical word and removes evidence of cognitive and speech collapse.

findings.highlight:
A sword is in my hand.
 is      body      last
findings.evidenceJa:
手に剣を。
はもしない体で、最後の、
findings.governingReading: A sword is in his hand as the damaged bodily sentence begins a final action and fails.
findings.explanation: The English collapses further into an unintelligible word skeleton rather than preserving the source fragment’s remaining syntax.

findings.highlight: The voice of someone I can’t remember.
findings.evidenceJa: もう名前も思い出せない、誰かの声。
findings.governingReading: It is the voice of someone whose name Shirou can no longer remember.
findings.explanation: The English broadens failure to retrieve the name into failure to remember the person at all.

findings.highlight: no matter what kind of life you become
findings.evidenceJa: どんな命になっても、どんなカタチになっても
findings.governingReading: Illya asks whether Shirou wants to live regardless of what kind of life and what physical form result.
findings.explanation: The English removes the separate condition concerning his resulting form.

findings.highlight: I wanted you to live instead of me.
findings.evidenceJa: わたしよりシロウに、これからを生きてほしかった
findings.governingReading: Illya wanted Shirou, more than herself, to live the life or future that comes next.
findings.explanation: Instead of me turns comparative priority into simple substitution and drops the future-directed object.

findings.highlight: I’ll take him
findings.evidenceJa: そいつは、俺が連れて行くから
findings.governingReading: Shirou says he will take that entity or thing with him.
findings.explanation: The English again supplies a male human pronoun for the still-unborn entity.

findings.highlight: an application of the magic I showed you earlier
findings.evidenceJa: 前に見せた魔術の応用
findings.governingReading: Illya calls this an application of the magecraft she showed earlier.
findings.explanation: The English calls magecraft magic immediately before the source deliberately invokes true Magic.

findings.highlight: becomes the sacrifice, just like in the first ritual to close the Great Holy Grail.
findings.evidenceJa: 初めの儀式のように、起動のための生贄になって、大聖杯を閉ざしていく。
findings.governingReading: As in the first ritual, Illya becomes the sacrifice used for activation and proceeds to close the Greater Grail.
findings.explanation: English attachment can make closing the Grail the purpose of the first ritual rather than Illya’s present act after becoming an activation sacrifice.

findings.highlight: I’m glad we were siblings.
findings.evidenceJa: シロウと兄妹で、本当に良かった。
findings.governingReading: Illya is glad that she and Shirou were specifically brother and younger sister.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes the asymmetrical sibling roles that motivate the following role reversal.

findings.highlight: Butif one of us has to be sacrificed
findings.evidenceJa: それでもそれでも、どちらかが犠牲になるというのなら
findings.governingReading: Even so, if either of them must become the sacrifice, Shirou begins his answer.
findings.explanation: A missing space visibly fuses the conjunction and conditional.

findings.highlight: The girl who was left alone because I came and stole him.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺が横取りして、ずっと一人にさせてしまった幼い少女。
findings.governingReading: Shirou calls her the young girl he left alone by stealing Kiritsugu away.
findings.explanation: The English adds his arrival as a causal action and drops the description of Illya as young.

findings.highlight:
“IllyaIllya, Illya, Illya, Illya,
 Illya, Illya, Illya,
 Illya!!!”
findings.evidenceJa: 「イリヤイリヤ、イリヤ、イリヤ、イリヤ、イリヤ！！！」
findings.governingReading: Shirou cries Illya’s name six times in a single escalating outburst.
findings.explanation: The English inflates the repetition count and reformats the cry into three tiers not present in the source.

findings.highlight: shuts the gate of the Great Holy Grail.
findings.evidenceJa: パタン、と大聖杯の門を閉めた。
findings.governingReading: Illya closes the Greater Grail’s gate with a light patan snap or clap.
findings.explanation: The English removes the audible finality of the gate closing.

findings.highlight: [blank page]
findings.evidenceJa: 空が、見える。
findings.governingReading: Shirou can see the sky.
findings.explanation: The English leaves the active turning-point line blank.

findings.highlight: I can go into the sky if I reach out just a bit.
findings.evidenceJa: ほんの少し、ただ腕を伸ばすだけで、空へ抜ける。
findings.governingReading: By reaching his arm only a little farther, Shirou can break through or emerge into the sky.
findings.explanation: The English turns physical escape through an opening into going into the sky.

findings.highlight: There’s absolutely no energy left in my body.
findings.evidenceJa: 一欠片の魔力も残っていない。
findings.governingReading: Not one fragment of magical energy remains in his body.
findings.explanation: The English removes the technical resource and renders it as generic energy.

findings.highlight:
I feel something cold in my hand.
The sensation rouses my mind
findings.evidenceJa: 手のひらには冷たい痛み。
findings.governingReading: A cold pain in Shirou’s palm wakes his sinking consciousness.
findings.explanation: The English removes pain and converts it into an unspecified cold object or sensation.

findings.highlight: [blank page]
findings.evidenceJa: “だいじょうぶ。リンが助けてくれるから”
findings.governingReading: Illya’s remembered reassurance says that Rin will save him.
findings.explanation: The English leaves the active reassurance blank, removing Rin from the survival chain.

findings.highlight: A little magical energy.
findings.evidenceJa: ほんの一呼吸分の魔力。
findings.governingReading: The pendant holds only one breath’s worth of magical energy.
findings.explanation: The English removes the exact tiny reserve that bounds what Shirou can still do.

findings.highlight: help me reach out with my hands
findings.evidenceJa: 手を伸ばすぐらいは助けてくれる
findings.governingReading: The pendant can help him extend a hand.
findings.explanation: The English pluralizes the hand in the climax’s repeated single-hand action.

findings.highlight: The gentle atmosphere and the warm sun hits my skin.
findings.evidenceJa: 柔らかい大気は肌に、温かい陽を受ける。
findings.governingReading: His skin meets soft air and receives warm sunlight.
findings.explanation: The English both breaks subject-verb agreement and collapses two kinds of contact into one thing hitting his skin.

findings.highlight: [blank page]
findings.evidenceJa: この手には、果てのない青い空が
findings.governingReading: The unfinished line places the endless blue sky within Shirou’s reaching hand.
findings.explanation: The English leaves the active climax fragment blank.
